scriptData.label: Roll to remove Stunned
@effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The projectile crashes into the inside of your upper arm near the armpit. The humerus (the long bone in the upper arm) cracks lengthwise into several fragments, resulting in long shards of sharp bone that tear through the surrounding soft tissues. One such bony knife rips through your brachial artery, causing massive internal bleeding!

Effects: You gain @Condition[Stunned] (2) and @Condition[Bleeding] (3), the latter of which can only be removed through Surgery. Should you survive you’ll also have Broken Bone (Major).
